U.note: Huge legible time and mode, drift-free end-time clock, auto phase switch with chime and cue, role=timer and aria-live, keyboard shortcuts; phone layout is a little loose and the confirm() dialog is a minor wart.

V.note: Warm, polished and accessible with a progress road to the long break, but localStorage restore, auto-advance and the road widget overbuild a simple timer and the source is long.

W.note: Attractive ring card with tabs and settings, accurate countdown and auto switching, but no screen-reader semantics, a new AudioContext per beep and only Space/R shortcuts.

X.note: Distinctive terminal look with solid logic, but the ASCII bar, text-only buttons, reset confirmation, auto and sound toggles are overbuilt and the status text is dense on phones.

Y.note: Genuinely simple and tidy ring timer with tabs, but it plays a beep and switches silently with no status, has no skip or timer semantics, and lacks keyboard shortcuts beyond Space.

Z.note: Bold full-bleed colour per phase, huge time, progress bar, accurate timing, clear status, screen-reader timer text, keyboard shortcuts and good phone layout; slightly many options but cohesive.
